message:
fix: export DataTransformer interface marked as @public (#6927)

# Pull Request Summary: Export DataTransformer Interface #6916 

## Description
This PR resolves an issue where the `DataTransformer` interface was
marked as `@public` but not exported from either `@trpc/server` or
`@trpc/client` packages, preventing users from properly typing their
custom transformers.

## Issue Fixed
- **Problem**: Users couldn't import `DataTransformer` interface despite
it being marked as public API
- **Workaround**: Users had to use confusing
`CombinedDataTransformer["input"]` hack
- **Root Cause**: Missing exports in package entry points
- 
##  Changes Made
### Server Package (`@trpc/server`)
- Added `DataTransformer` export to main index
- Added `TRPCDataTransformer` alias following naming conventions
- Added backward compatibility deprecation notice

### Client Package (`@trpc/client`) 
- Added convenient re-export of `DataTransformer` from server package
- Maintains single source of truth

## Testing
- [x] All packages build successfully
- [x] Type exports verified in built packages
- [x] Existing transformer tests pass
- [x] No breaking changes introduced
- [x] Backward compatibility maintained
## Usage
### Before
```typescript
import type { DataTransformer } from '@trpc/server';
type MyTransformer = CombinedDataTransformer["input"];
```
### After
```typescript
import type { DataTransformer } from '@trpc/server';
import type { DataTransformer } from '@trpc/client';
const myTransformer: DataTransformer = {
  serialize: (obj) => obj,
  deserialize: (obj) => obj,
};
```
## Safety
- **Breaking Changes**: None
- **Runtime Impact**: None (types only)
- **Backward Compatibility**: Full
- **Code Style**: Follows project conventions
